limitations: Local synthetic two-route counter workload, not framework-wide performance parity.
Shared host, no CPU affinity/cgroup/network throttle; descriptive percentiles only.
Browser FCP/LCP/CLS are lab observations, not field Web Vitals, INP or real devices.
Readiness marks are application instrumentation, not complete framework hydration.
RSS/HWM are server process snapshots, excluding browsers, descendants and machine memory.
Load timing includes local client and response consumption; requests/second does not establish saturation.
Startup has one process observation per variant, with warm OS/dependency caches.
No hosted/serverless/CDN performance or release budget approval.
